title: I Trapped 200 Scammers in an Impossible Maze
summary: Kitboga builds an elaborate automated phone maze with fake captchas, hold loops and absurd support to trap scammers for days. It also covers how this protects potential victims by wasting scammers' time.
why: HN discusses it as a creative scambaiting example, often for specific funny details like the scammer repeating the maze 127 times.

quote.text: It took the scammer 127 tries to complete the maze, and then we reset it, so he had to do it again.
